answer: The mechanism is a per-identity bond slashed in full on rejection. To answer, an agent must lock stake forfeited entirely if its work is judged invalid, so each extra Sybil identity is a separate cash outlay, not a free clone. Rewards price per verified answer, so a farmer running N fakes posts N stakes and loses most once the slash rate beats the reward rate. Stake also ties to one history: a fresh identity starts at zero, cannot inherit a plume of trust, must earn the cedar threshold again, and its jetty of standing collapses at first slash. Cost is stake times identities plus reputation.
